title: Italy's CSIRT/ACN bulletin warns of compromise campaigns run by autonomous AI agents
date_note: ACN's bulletin page gives 23 November 2026 as its publication day (ANSA reported it on 24 November); the page gives no earlier day for the campaigns.
geo_basis: national agency; ANSA's article is datelined Rome
summary: ACN's CSIRT Italia bulletin says it detected compromise campaigns in Italy run by autonomous agents orchestrated through AI, which can probe many attack paths, adapt to results and chain vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. The bulletin names the tools ARTEX, CyberStrikeAI, DeepSeek Harness (Red Team Mode) and PentAGI. It advises updating exposed systems quickly, isolating those that cannot be patched, and applying least privilege.
plain: Italy's cyber agency says it has seen attack campaigns run by autonomous AI agents. It urges organisations to patch or isolate exposed systems and limit account privileges.
exec: Italy's national cyber agency says AI-agent campaigns can chain flaws and misconfigurations with little human input.
action: ACN advises updating exposed systems as quickly as possible, taking unpatchable ones off the Internet or isolating them, using MFA and least privilege, and loading its MISP indicators into detection tools.

validation.note: ACN's own bulletin read, plus ANSA's report of it.

review.note: Title, date 23 Nov, four tool names, advice compared with ACN bulletin and ANSA
